ucs.title: [LLM] Bluenoroff/TA444 SnatchCrypto chain: ISO/IMG MOTW bypass dropping signed-binary DLL loader
ucs.description: Hunts Bluenoroff's signature first-stage delivery — a recruiter/VC-themed phishing lure delivering an ISO/IMG/VHD container that defeats Mark-of-the-Web, then user-clicks an LNK on the mounted volume which spawns rundll32.exe/regsvr32.exe to load a payload DLL from AppData/Downloads/Temp by export ordinal or name. This chain is documented in Kaspersky's SnatchCrypto reporting and Microsoft's Sapphire Sleet write-ups on the macOS-and-Windows fake-job lure campaigns (a.k.a. NICKEL GLADSTONE / Stardust Chollima).
ucs.splunk:
| tstats summariesonly=true count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(Filesystem.file_path) as iso_path from datamodel=Endpoint.Filesystem where Filesystem.file_name IN ("*.iso","*.img","*.vhd","*.vhdx") Filesystem.process_name IN ("outlook.exe","chrome.exe","msedge.exe","firefox.exe","explorer.exe","OneDrive.exe") by host Filesystem.user Filesystem.file_name Filesystem.process_name _time span=1h
| rename host as src, Filesystem.* as *
| join type=inner src [
    | tstats summariesonly=true count values(Processes.process) as cmdline values(Processes.parent_process_name) as parent from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where Processes.process_name IN ("rundll32.exe","regsvr32.exe") Processes.parent_process_name="explorer.exe" (Processes.process="*\\AppData\\*" OR Processes.process="*\\Downloads\\*" OR Processes.process="*\\Temp\\*" OR Processes.process="*\\\\?\\*") (Processes.process="*.dll*" OR Processes.process="*.ocx*" OR Processes.process="*.cpl*") by host Processes.user Processes.process_name _time span=1h
    | rename host as src, Processes.* as *
    | where match(cmdline, "(?i)\b(#\d+|,\s*[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_]{2,})\b")
]
| eval delta_sec=lastTime-firstTime
| where delta_sec < 1800
| table firstTime src user iso_path parent process_name cmdline delta_sec
| sort - firstTime
ucs.kql:
let LookbackDays = 14d;
let WindowMinutes = 30m;
let IsoDrops = DeviceFileEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where FileName endswith ".iso" or FileName endswith ".img" or FileName endswith ".vhd" or FileName endswith ".vhdx"
    | where InitiatingProcessFileName in~ ("outlook.exe","chrome.exe","msedge.exe","firefox.exe","brave.exe","explorer.exe","onedrive.exe","teams.exe")
    | project DropTime = Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName,
              ContainerName = FileName,
              ContainerPath = FolderPath,
              DropAccount = InitiatingProcessAccountName,
              Deliverer = InitiatingProcessFileName;
let LoaderExec = DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where FileName in~ ("rundll32.exe","regsvr32.exe")
    | where InitiatingProcessFileName =~ "explorer.exe"
    | where ProcessCommandLine has_any (".dll",".ocx",".cpl")
    | where ProcessCommandLine matches regex @"(?i)\\AppData\\(Local|Roaming)\\|\\Users\\[^\\]+\\Downloads\\|\\Temp\\|\\\\\?\\[A-Z]:\\"
    | where ProcessCommandLine matches regex @"(?i),\s*(#\d+|[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_]{2,})\s*$|(?i)\s/s\s|DllRegisterServer"
    | where AccountName !endswith "$"
    | project LoaderTime = Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName, AccountName,
              Loader = FileName, LoaderCmd = ProcessCommandLine,
              LoaderHash = SHA256;
IsoDrops
| join kind=inner LoaderExec on DeviceId
| where LoaderTime between (DropTime .. DropTime + WindowMinutes)
| extend DelaySec = datetime_diff('second', LoaderTime, DropTime)
| project DropTime, LoaderTime, DelaySec, DeviceName, AccountName,
          Deliverer, ContainerName, ContainerPath,
          Loader, LoaderCmd, LoaderHash
| order by LoaderTime desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
let LookbackDays = 14d;
let WindowSec = 1800;
let IsoDrops = ImFileEvent
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where TargetFileExtension in~ ("iso","img","vhd","vhdx")
    | where ActingProcessName has_any ("outlook.exe","chrome.exe","msedge.exe","firefox.exe","brave.exe","explorer.exe","onedrive.exe","teams.exe")
    | project DropTime = TimeGenerated, DvcHostname,
              ContainerName = TargetFileName,
              ContainerPath = TargetFilePath,
              DropAccount = ActorUsername,
              Deliverer = ActingProcessName;
let LoaderExec = ImProcessCreate
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where TargetProcessName has_any ("rundll32.exe","regsvr32.exe")
    | where ParentProcessName has "explorer.exe"
    | where TargetProcessCommandLine has_any (".dll",".ocx",".cpl")
    | where TargetProcessCommandLine matches regex @"(?i)\\AppData\\(Local|Roaming)\\|\\Users\\[^\\]+\\Downloads\\|\\Temp\\|\\\\\?\\[A-Z]:\\"
    | where TargetProcessCommandLine matches regex @"(?i),\s*(#\d+|[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_]{2,})\s*$|(?i)\s/s\s|DllRegisterServer"
    | where ActorUsername !endswith "$"
    | project LoaderTime = TimeGenerated, DvcHostname, ActorUsername,
              Loader = TargetProcessName,
              LoaderCmd = TargetProcessCommandLine,
              LoaderHash = SHA256;
IsoDrops
| join kind=inner LoaderExec on DvcHostname
| where datetime_diff('second', LoaderTime, DropTime) between (0 .. WindowSec)
| extend DelaySec = datetime_diff('second', LoaderTime, DropTime)
| project DropTime, LoaderTime, DelaySec, DvcHostname, ActorUsername,
          Deliverer, ContainerName, ContainerPath,
          Loader, LoaderCmd, LoaderHash
| order by LoaderTime desc
ucs.datadog_query: source:windows.sysmon @EventID:1 @ParentImage:(*\explorer.exe OR *\EXPLORER.EXE) @Image:(*\rundll32.exe OR *\Rundll32.exe OR *\RUNDLL32.EXE OR *\regsvr32.exe OR *\Regsvr32.exe OR *\REGSVR32.EXE) @CommandLine:(*AppData* OR *Downloads* OR *\Temp\* OR *\\?\*) @CommandLine:(*.dll* OR *.ocx* OR *.cpl*) -@User:(*SYSTEM* OR *system*)
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2 ParentBaseFileName=/explorer\.exe/i ImageFileName=/(rundll32|regsvr32)\.exe$/i
| regex("(?i)\\\\AppData\\\\(Local|Roaming)\\\\|\\\\Downloads\\\\|\\\\Temp\\\\|\\\\\\\\\\?\\\\", field=CommandLine)
| regex("(?i)\\.(dll|ocx|cpl)", field=CommandLine)
| regex("(?i),\\s*(#\\d+|[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_]{2,})\\s*$|\\s/s\\s|DllRegisterServer", field=CommandLine)
| NOT UserName=/^(SYSTEM|LOCAL SERVICE|NETWORK SERVICE)$/i
| join({#event_simpleName=FileWritten TargetFileName=/\.(iso|img|vhd|vhdx)$/i ContextImageFileName=/(outlook|chrome|msedge|firefox|brave|explorer|onedrive|teams)\.exe$/i}, field=aid, include=[TargetFileName, ContextImageFileName, _time], mode=left)
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, UserName, ImageFileName, CommandLine, TargetFileName], function=[min(_time, as=first), max(_time, as=last)])
| sort(last, order=desc)
ucs.rationale: Bluenoroff/TA444's SnatchCrypto and 'Hidden Risk' / fake-recruiter campaigns consistently chain ISO/IMG containers (MOTW evasion) with an LNK that invokes rundll32 or regsvr32 against a side-loaded DLL with an unusual export ordinal or name. Generic LOLBin hunts catch noisy execution; pairing the ISO drop by a mail/browser process with explorer-parented rundll32/regsvr32 against AppData/Downloads/

ucs.title: [LLM] Bluenoroff crypto-wallet & browser credential exfil: non-browser process reading Chromium Login Data and wallet extension stores
ucs.description: Hunts the post-implant data-theft stage that defines Bluenoroff (a.k.a. APT38 / TA444 / Sapphire Sleet / Stardust Chollima / BeagleBoyz): the actor's stealer modules (e.g. SnatchCrypto, ObjCShellz/RustBucket Windows counterparts, and the 'CryptoCore' tooling) read Chromium 'Login Data' / 'Cookies' SQLite files and enumerate MetaMask, Phantom, Coinbase Wallet, TronLink, BinanceChain, Keplr browser-extension storage directories from a non-browser process — directly tied to their financial-theft motivation.
ucs.splunk:
| tstats summariesonly=true count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(Filesystem.file_path) as paths values(Filesystem.file_name) as files from datamodel=Endpoint.Filesystem where (Filesystem.file_path="*\\Google\\Chrome\\User Data\\*\\Login Data*" OR Filesystem.file_path="*\\Google\\Chrome\\User Data\\*\\Cookies*" OR Filesystem.file_path="*\\Google\\Chrome\\User Data\\*\\Local State*" OR Filesystem.file_path="*\\Microsoft\\Edge\\User Data\\*\\Login Data*" OR Filesystem.file_path="*\\Mozilla\\Firefox\\Profiles\\*\\logins.json*" OR Filesystem.file_path="*\\Mozilla\\Firefox\\Profiles\\*\\cookies.sqlite*" OR Filesystem.file_path="*\\Local Extension Settings\\nkbihfbeogaeaoehlefnkodbefgpgknn*" OR Filesystem.file_path="*\\Local Extension Settings\\bfnaelmomeimhlpmgjnjophhpkkoljpa*" OR Filesystem.file_path="*\\Local Extension Settings\\ejbalbakoplchlghecdalmeeeajnimhm*" OR Filesystem.file_path="*\\Local Extension Settings\\ibnejdfjmmkpcnlpebklmnkoeoihofec*" OR Filesystem.file_path="*\\Local Extension Settings\\fhbohimaelbohpjbbldcngcnapndodjp*" OR Filesystem.file_path="*\\Local Extension Settings\\hnfanknocfeofbddgcijnmhnfnkdnaad*" OR Filesystem.file_path="*\\Local Extension Settings\\dmkamcknogkgcdfhhbddcghachkejeap*" OR Filesystem.file_path="*\\Local Extension Settings\\jbdaocneiiinmjbjlgalhcelgbejmnid*" OR Filesystem.file_path="*\\Local Extension Settings\\fnjhmkhhmkbjkkabndcnnogagogbneec*") Filesystem.process_name!="chrome.exe" Filesystem.process_name!="msedge.exe" Filesystem.process_name!="firefox.exe" Filesystem.process_name!="brave.exe" Filesystem.process_name!="OneDrive.exe" Filesystem.process_name!="backup.exe" Filesystem.process_name!="MsMpEng.exe" Filesystem.process_name!="SearchProtocolHost.exe" Filesystem.process_name!="explorer.exe" by host Filesystem.user Filesystem.process_name Filesystem.process_path _time span=10m
| rename Filesystem.* as *
| eventstats dc(file_name) as distinct_targets by host user process_name
| where distinct_targets >= 2 OR match(paths, "(?i)Local Extension Settings\\\\(nkbihfbeogaeaoehlefnkodbefgpgknn|bfnaelmomeimhlpmgjnjophhpkkoljpa|ibnejdfjmmkpcnlpebklmnkoeoihofec)")
| table firstTime lastTime host user process_name process_path distinct_targets paths
| sort - lastTime
ucs.kql:
let LookbackDays = 7d;
let WalletExtIds = dynamic([
    "nkbihfbeogaeaoehlefnkodbefgpgknn",  // MetaMask
    "ejbalbakoplchlghecdalmeeeajnimhm",  // MetaMask (Edge)
    "bfnaelmomeimhlpmgjnjophhpkkoljpa",  // Phantom
    "ibnejdfjmmkpcnlpebklmnkoeoihofec",  // TronLink
    "fhbohimaelbohpjbbldcngcnapndodjp",  // BinanceChain
    "hnfanknocfeofbddgcijnmhnfnkdnaad",  // Keplr
    "dmkamcknogkgcdfhhbddcghachkejeap",  // Keplr (alt)
    "jbdaocneiiinmjbjlgalhcelgbejmnid",  // Coinbase
    "fnjhmkhhmkbjkkabndcnnogagogbneec",  // Ronin
    "egjidjbpglichdcondbcbdnbeeppgdph"]); // Trust Wallet
let CredFilePaths = dynamic([
    @"\Google\Chrome\User Data\",
    @"\Microsoft\Edge\User Data\",
    @"\BraveSoftware\Brave-Browser\User Data\",
    @"\Mozilla\Firefox\Profiles\"]);
let BrowserBins = dynamic(["chrome.exe","msedge.exe","firefox.exe","brave.exe","opera.exe","iexplore.exe"]);
let TrustedReaders = dynamic(["OneDrive.exe","MsMpEng.exe","SenseIR.exe","MsSense.exe","backup.exe","SearchProtocolHost.exe","explorer.exe","WmiPrvSE.exe"]);
DeviceFileEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
| where ActionType in ("FileCreated","FileModified","FileRenamed")
     or FileName in~ ("Login Data","Cookies","Local State","logins.json","cookies.sqlite","key4.db","Web Data")
| where (FileName in~ ("Login Data","Cookies","Local State","logins.json","cookies.sqlite","key4.db","Web Data"))
     or FolderPath has_any (WalletExtIds)
| where FolderPath has_any (CredFilePaths) or FolderPath has "Local Extension Settings"
| where InitiatingProcessFileName !in~ BrowserBins
| where InitiatingProcessFileName !in~ TrustedReaders
| where InitiatingProcessAccountName !endswith "$"
| extend WalletHit = iff(FolderPath has_any (WalletExtIds), "wallet-extension", ""),
         CredHit   = iff(FileName in~ ("Login Data","Cookies","logins.json","cookies.sqlite","Local State","key4.db"), "browser-cred-store", "")
| summarize FirstSeen = min(Timestamp), LastSeen = max(Timestamp),
            DistinctTargets = dcount(strcat(WalletHit, CredHit, FileName)),
            TargetSample = make_set(FolderPath, 10),
            Cmd = any(InitiatingProcessCommandLine),
            Hash = any(InitiatingProcessSHA256)
            by DeviceName, InitiatingProcessAccountName,
               InitiatingProcessFileName, InitiatingProcessFolderPath
| where DistinctTargets >= 2 or array_length(TargetSample) >= 2
| order by LastSeen desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
let LookbackDays = 7d;
let WalletExtIds = dynamic([
    "nkbihfbeogaeaoehlefnkodbefgpgknn","ejbalbakoplchlghecdalmeeeajnimhm",
    "bfnaelmomeimhlpmgjnjophhpkkoljpa","ibnejdfjmmkpcnlpebklmnkoeoihofec",
    "fhbohimaelbohpjbbldcngcnapndodjp","hnfanknocfeofbddgcijnmhnfnkdnaad",
    "dmkamcknogkgcdfhhbddcghachkejeap","jbdaocneiiinmjbjlgalhcelgbejmnid",
    "fnjhmkhhmkbjkkabndcnnogagogbneec","egjidjbpglichdcondbcbdnbeeppgdph"]);
let BrowserBins = dynamic(["chrome.exe","msedge.exe","firefox.exe","brave.exe","opera.exe","iexplore.exe"]);
let TrustedReaders = dynamic(["onedrive.exe","msmpeng.exe","senseir.exe","mssense.exe","backup.exe","searchprotocolhost.exe","explorer.exe","wmiprvse.exe"]);
ImFileEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackDays)
| where (TargetFileName in~ ("Login Data","Cookies","Local State","logins.json","cookies.sqlite","key4.db","Web Data"))
     or TargetFilePath has_any (WalletExtIds)
| where TargetFilePath has_any (@"\Chrome\User Data\", @"\Edge\User Data\", @"\Brave-Browser\User Data\", @"\Firefox\Profiles\", @"Local Extension Settings")
| where tolower(ActingProcessName) !in (BrowserBins)
| where tolower(ActingProcessName) !in (TrustedReaders)
| where ActorUsername !endswith "$"
| summarize FirstSeen = min(TimeGenerated), LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated),
            DistinctTargets = dcount(TargetFileName),
            TargetSample = make_set(TargetFilePath, 10),
            Cmd = any(ActingProcessCommandLine),
            Hash = any(TargetFileSHA256)
            by DvcHostname, ActorUsername, ActingProcessName
| where DistinctTargets >= 2 or array_length(TargetSample) >= 2
| order by LastSeen desc
ucs.sigma_yaml:
title: Bluenoroff Crypto Wallet & Browser Credential Store Access by Non-Browser Process
id: a8e21d5e-3d2a-4b9f-9b9b-bluenoroff-wallet-theft
status: experimental
description: Detects non-browser processes opening or copying Chromium/Firefox credential databases or accessing MetaMask/Phantom/Coinbase/Keplr/TronLink/BinanceChain browser-extension storage — Bluenoroff/TA444 SnatchCrypto post-implant tradecraft.
references:
  - https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0082/
  - https://securelist.com/the-bluenoroff-cryptocurrency-hunt-is-still-on/105488/
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/05/28
tags:
  - attack.credential_access
  - attack.collection
  - attack.t1539
  - attack.t1555.003
  - attack.t1176
  - attack.g0082
logsource:
  product: windows
  category: file_event
detection:
  selection_cred_files:
    TargetFilename|endswith:
      - '\Login Data'
      - '\Cookies'
      - '\Local State'
      - '\Web Data'
      - '\logins.json'
      - '\cookies.sqlite'
      - '\key4.db'
  selection_wallet_paths:
    TargetFilename|contains:
      - '\Local Extension Settings\nkbihfbeogaeaoehlefnkodbefgpgknn'
      - '\Local Extension Settings\ejbalbakoplchlghecdalmeeeajnimhm'
      - '\Local Extension Settings\bfnaelmomeimhlpmgjnjophhpkkoljpa'
      - '\Local Extension Settings\ibnejdfjmmkpcnlpebklmnkoeoihofec'
      - '\Local Extension Settings\fhbohimaelbohpjbbldcngcnapndodjp'
      - '\Local Extension Settings\hnfanknocfeofbddgcijnmhnfnkdnaad'
      - '\Local Extension Settings\jbdaocneiiinmjbjlgalhcelgbejmnid'
      - '\Local Extension Settings\fnjhmkhhmkbjkkabndcnnogagogbneec'
      - '\Local Extension Settings\egjidjbpglichdcondbcbdnbeeppgdph'
  filter_browsers:
    Image|endswith:
      - '\chrome.exe'
      - '\msedge.exe'
      - '\firefox.exe'
      - '\brave.exe'
      - '\opera.exe'
  filter_trusted:
    Image|endswith:
      - '\OneDrive.exe'
      - '\MsMpEng.exe'
      - '\MsSense.exe'
      - '\SenseIR.exe'
      - '\SearchProtocolHost.exe'
      - '\explorer.exe'
      - '\WmiPrvSE.exe'
  condition: (selection_cred_files or selection_wallet_paths) and not (filter_browsers or filter_trusted)
falsepositives:
  - Enterprise backup / sync agents reading user profile (add to filter_trusted)
  - DLP/EDR agents inspecting credential stores
level: high
